children: Phillips 66's board has raised the downstream energy provider's quarterly dividend by 4.7%, to $1.33 from $1.27.
The new payout, equal to $5.32 a year, represents an annual yield of about 1.82% based on Friday's trading price of $291.87, up from 1.74%.
The Houston company said the increased dividend is payable Dec. 1 to shareholders of record Nov. 17.
